name: engineering-baseline-unlock-execution-doc
title: Write the formal Layer 2 Engineering Baseline unlock execution document
description: Create or refine the execution document for formally unlocking Layer 2 Engineering Baseline. The document must explain how Lattice proves real engineering development capability through ENG baselines, multi-host audit discipline, evidence contracts, fail-closed rules, and sequential unlock boundaries. It must not add arbitrary optimization or overclaim production unattended development.
